Args:
set -euo pipefail
umask 077
mkdir -m 0700 /tmp/pair-output /tmp/pair-input
exec 3>&1
exec > /tmp/pair-output/runtime.txt 2>&1
collect() {
  runtime_status=$?
  trap - EXIT
  set +e
  printf '%s\n' "$runtime_status" > /tmp/pair-output/runtime-exit.txt
  roots=(tmp/pair-output)
  for path in var/lib/lampOS var/lib/lampos-skills-state; do
    if [ -d "/$path" ]; then roots+=("$path"); fi
  done
  cd /
  find "${roots[@]}" -type f \
    ! -name lamp-skills-6408 ! -name lamp-skills-6498 \
    ! -name lamp-cloud-6408 ! -name lamp-cloud-6498 -print0 \
    | LC_ALL=C sort -z > /tmp/evidence-files
  list_status=$?
  if [ "$list_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit 97; fi
  timeout --kill-after=5s 30s tar --null --verbatim-files-from -T /tmp/evidence-files -czf - >&3
  archive_status=$?
  if [ "$archive_status" -ne 0 ]; then exit 98; fi
  exit "$runtime_status"
}
trap collect EXIT
test "$(id -u)" = 0
test "$(uname -m)" = aarch64
tar --no-same-owner -xf - -C /tmp/pair-input
(
  cd /tmp/pair-input
  sha256sum --check --strict SHA256SUMS
)
cp /tmp/pair-input/SHA256SUMS /tmp/pair-output/verified-inputs.sha256
for binary in /tmp/pair-input/cloud-release-pair /tmp/pair-input/lamp-*; do
  timeout 20s ldd "$binary" > "/tmp/pair-output/$(basename "$binary").ldd.txt" 2>&1
  ! grep -q 'not found' "/tmp/pair-output/$(basename "$binary").ldd.txt"
done
printf 'lamp-cloud-provenance-pair network-none tmpfs-v1\n' > /run/lamp-cloud-pair-isolated
chmod 0400 /run/lamp-cloud-pair-isolated
test ! -e /var/lib/lampOS && test ! -e /var/lib/lampos-skills-state
set +e
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 300s /tmp/pair-input/cloud-release-pair \
  --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1 > /tmp/pair-output/tests.txt 2>&1
test_status=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$test_status" > /tmp/pair-output/test-exit.txt
test "$test_status" = 0 || exit "$test_status"
test ! -e /var/lib/lampOS && test ! -e /var/lib/lampos-skills-state
printf 'fixed_paths_absent=true\n' > /tmp/pair-output/fixed-paths-after.txt
(
  cd /tmp/pair-input
  sha256sum --check --strict SHA256SUMS
)
